message.content: hey - first time using claude on this repo. can you add cursor pagination to GET /v1/endpoints/:id/deliveries? right now it's just `limit`. accept `?cursor=<delivery id>` and return `{ items, nextCursor }` where nextCursor is null on the last page

content.text: I'll start by getting a map of how deliveries are stored and served.

input.prompt: In /work/tallyhook (pnpm monorepo), find everything involved in serving GET /v1/endpoints/:id/deliveries: the route, the zod query schema, the Prisma model and indexes, and how the existing route tests mock Prisma. Report file paths, the relevant functions and anything that would matter for adding cursor pagination. Do not edit anything.

content.text:
Findings:

- Route: `packages/api/src/routes/deliveries.ts` - single handler, parses `listDeliveriesQuery` and calls `prisma.delivery.findMany({ where: { endpointId, status }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: q.limit })`, returns `{ items }`.
- Query schema: `packages/shared/src/schemas.ts` - `listDeliveriesQuery` has `limit` (coerced, 1-100, default 50) and optional `status`.
- Model: `Delivery` in `packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma`, `id` is a cuid, there is an index on `[endpointId, createdAt]`. `createdAt` is not unique, so a stable order needs `id` as a tie-breaker.
- Tests: `packages/api/src/routes/endpoints.test.ts` mocks `@tallyhook/shared` with `vi.hoisted` + `vi.mock`, keeps the real zod schemas via `vi.importActual`, and stubs `../queue`. There is no test file for deliveries yet.

Nothing else in api or worker calls `listDeliveriesQuery`.

- Query schema: `packages/shared/src/schemas.ts` - `listDeliveriesQuery` has `limit` (coerced, 1-100, default 50) and optional `status`.
- Model: `Delivery` in `packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma`, `id` is a cuid, there is an index on `[endpointId, createdAt]`. `createdAt` is not unique, so a stable order needs `id` as a tie-breaker.

Plan: add an optional `cursor` to the query schema, fetch `limit + 1` rows ordered by `createdAt desc, id desc` so I can tell whether there's another page, and use Prisma's cursor with `skip: 1`.

content.text:
Cursor pagination is in.

- `listDeliveriesQuery` accepts an optional `cursor` (`packages/shared/src/schemas.ts`).
- The route fetches `limit + 1` rows ordered by `createdAt desc, id desc`, uses Prisma's `cursor` + `skip: 1`, and returns `{ items, nextCursor }` with `nextCursor: null` on the last page.
- New `packages/api/src/routes/deliveries.test.ts` covers both cases.

`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass. Note: on this checkout the Prisma client hadn't been generated yet, so I ran `pnpm --filter @tallyhook/shared db:generate` before typechecking.
